intro: The SC02's low entrance and open layout make it easy for cats to use, and there is only limited documented support for it so far. This page covers what Meowant publishes; the common troubleshooting page covers the rest.

facts.text: Rated for cats from 3.3 to 22 lb.
A 6.8 in entrance, the lowest published in our index.

symptoms.title: A small kitten does not register
symptoms.summary: A very young cat uses the box without it registering.
causes: Meowant rates the SC02 from 3.3 lb.

fixes.detail: Introduce the SC02 once the kitten is over 3.3 lb.

symptoms.escalate: If a heavier cat is not registering, contact Meowant.
